public_rationale: Cost-recovery pricing and alternative-model development challenge the universal description. But the readable records do not establish a target-quarter counterexample on matched customer receipts and actual supplier charges. They also do not establish the claimed explanation about willingness to pay. The universal subsidy claim remains unproven; the available counterevidence is insufficient for a definitive contradiction under the contextual reading.
limitations: A literal reading covering unrelated AI businesses would be broader than the surrounding argument.
Positive gross margin, token cost recovery, and overall profitability are different measures.
The inaccessible margin report is excluded.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Every AI startup is effectively an extraction mechanism for OpenAI and Anthropic, reselling their tokens at a massive discount because users are unwilling to pay the actual cost of using LLMs.

statement.excerpt: Every AI startup is effectively an extraction mechanism for OpenAI and Anthropic, reselling their tokens through their services at a massive discount because users are unwilling to pay the actual cost of using LLMs.

from_speaker: an extraction mechanism for OpenAI and Anthropic
because users are unwilling to pay the actual cost
our_interpretation: In context, AI startup means an AI application business using these providers' models, rather than every hardware, robotics, or model-training company.
The plain reading is that each such startup materially subsidizes customers' token consumption because customers will not pay enough to cover the supplier cost.
The comparison is aggregate realized customer payments against actual supplier charges after discounts, not the maximum usage permitted to one heavy user.
The latest completed quarter before publication, July through September 2026, is used for current operating economics.
The surrounding comparisons use reported margins and estimated token costs, so the financial basis is estimate.
criteria.support_condition: Records covering the relevant startup population show material token resale subsidies at every firm, together with demand or pricing evidence establishing insufficient willingness to pay as the cause.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A relevant startup demonstrably covers its actual token supplier costs through customer payments without the claimed material subsidy, or reliable evidence disproves the asserted causal explanation.
